channel.title: Removal Queue Updates
channel.description: Updates for installed Removal Queue plug-ins.

item.title: Removal Queue 0.5.1 Preview
item.description:
Removal Queue 0.5.1 Preview simplifies marking and improves access to queued photos.
- Four panel buttons: Start/Stop Marking, Process Marked Photos, Settings, and Show Marked Photos. - The panel opens at the upper-left edge of the usable screen. Queue Details is inside Settings. - The large number counts photos with observed new saved marks, excluding empty visits. Multiple marks on one photo count once; undoing its new marks removes it from the count. - Show Marked Photos opens a collection maintained by the plug-in without moving files. Processed results remain available for review. - Processing gathers queued catalog photos into an unfiltered temporary collection, so other folders, filmstrip filters, and folder stacks do not prevent selection. A bounded wait allows the intended photo to load while unexpected navigation still stops the batch. - A paused operation shows its actual reason instead of generic red Needs review text.
Saved queues and independent update notifications are preserved. The displayed count can lag after rapid navigation or when first reopening an older batch; the processing scan verifies all tracked photos before confirmation. This remains a preview pending native testing of the new collection, counter, and filtered-batch workflow.
